Liam / Priya — thanks again for today's discovery call. I realize we missed the scheduled demo slot this afternoon (no worries — things happen). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: you want to validate inference latency/cost on ~2k qps peaks and confirm per-request isolation options for regulated data.
- Next step: 30-minute technical deep dive + sample workload run so we can scope Dedicated vs Hosted config.

I have a tight set of windows left this week and early next week. If you can pick one of the options below within 24 hours I'll lock it on our side; otherwise I'll open the slots for others. I want to minimize the back-and-forth since your calendar looked packed.

Available (all durations 30m, PT):
- Mon May 17 — 11:00–11:30am
- Mon May 17 — 4:00–4:30pm
- Tue May 18 — 9:00–9:30am

If none of these work, tell me your top two 30m windows and I’ll coordinate. Attaching the discovery notes and a light SOW template so your procurement folks can preview the scope.

Thanks — Aditya
